scope: Local sandbox and isolated WebMCP-shaped callbacks; no real Meta invocation or physical glasses execution verified.

review.privacy: Personal source notes, device nicknames, local paths and old commit identities excluded from the public snapshot.
review.technical: Bounded session history and exact-action authorization reviewed; no production security certification.
review.format: Prettier check passed for JavaScript, HTML, CSS and JSON.
review.dependencies: Existing Python environment passes pip check. npm vulnerability audit was attempted but its registry endpoint timed out; vulnerability coverage is incomplete.

limits: Effects stay in a tab-local synthetic notebook/inventory.
Trusted browser activation is not wearer identity or proof of attention.
Local hash consistency is not independent attestation or durable audit storage.
The optional local OCR/QR model study has no established attack-success rate.
The reference replay check was skipped because no stored receipts were present.
No public service deployment or real-account action is included.
